# Summary

### Objective

- Explore targeted scDNA data quality and availability for VHR-ALL patient samples
- Determine appropriate decision-making cutoffs and conditions for consensus
  genotypes and informative SNPs
- Define a distance metric between two sets of genotypes
- For pooled MRD samples, measure distance between each barcode and paired
  IDX samples

### Results

- scDNA data requires pre-processing steps to harmonise alternate alleles
  between paired samples (`bcftools` useful for sorting, indexing, selecting
  SNPs or targeted positions)
- ~3% of loaded cells are barcoded/sequenced
- Generally 2,000–5,000 barcoded cells per sample
- Different genotype quality cutoffs are appropriate in different contexts:
  - GQ = 99 for consensus genotype calls (require 95% of cells to agree)
  - GQ ≥ 20 adequate for cell-to-sample matching (allow 1 missing allele pair)
- Normalised Hamming distance captures proportion of shared genotypes while
  handling missing data
- 70–90% of pooled MRD barcodes can be uniquely assigned to one IDX sample

# Helper functions

```{r functions}
# get_consensus_genotype -------------------------------------------------------
# For a single-variant SNP data frame (one row per cell), returns:
#   - the consensus allele string (default)
#   - the consensus genotype string (return_genotype = TRUE)
#   - the proportion of cells with the most common genotype (return_prop = TRUE)
# A consensus is called only if >= cell_prop of cells passing the GQ threshold
# share the same genotype.
get_consensus_genotype <- function(snp_df,
                                   gq_min        = 99,
                                   cell_prop     = 0.95,
                                   return_genotype = FALSE,
                                   return_prop     = FALSE) {
  if (!is.numeric(gq_min) || gq_min < 0 || gq_min > 99)
    stop("gq_min must be a number in [0, 99]")
  if (!is.numeric(cell_prop) || cell_prop <= 0.5 || cell_prop > 1)
    stop("cell_prop must be a number in (0.5, 1]")

  pass_df <- snp_df |> dplyr::filter(quality >= gq_min)
  n_pass  <- nrow(pass_df)

  if (n_pass == 0) return(NA)

  pass_df <- pass_df |>
    dplyr::count(genotype, alleles) |>
    dplyr::mutate(prop = n / n_pass)

  if (return_prop) return(max(pass_df$prop))

  if (max(pass_df$prop) >= cell_prop) {
    max_allele <- pass_df$alleles[which.max(pass_df$prop)]
    max_gt     <- pass_df$genotype[which.max(pass_df$prop)]
    if (return_genotype) return(max_gt) else return(max_allele)
  }

  NA
}

# get_cell_genotypes / get_cell_alleles ----------------------------------------
# For a per-cell SNP data frame, returns a named list (one entry per variant)
# of genotype or allele strings. Calls below the GQ threshold are set to NA.
get_cell_genotypes <- function(cell_df, gq_min = 20) {
  cell_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(genotype = ifelse(quality >= gq_min, genotype, NA)) |>
    (\(x) split(x, f = x$variant))() |>
    purrr::map(\(x) x$genotype)
}

get_cell_alleles <- function(cell_df, gq_min = 20) {
  cell_df |>
    dplyr::mutate(alleles = ifelse(quality >= gq_min, alleles, NA)) |>
    (\(x) split(x, f = x$variant))() |>
    purrr::map(\(x) x$alleles)
}

# get_informative_variants -----------------------------------------------------
# Returns the subset of variants that are non-missing in all specified samples.
# Set keep_same_alleles = FALSE to retain only variants that differ across
# samples (used for demultiplexing pooled samples).
get_informative_variants <- function(alleles_list,
                                     sample_ids,
                                     stages,
                                     keep_same_alleles = TRUE) {
  purrr::map2(sample_ids, stages,
              \(x, y) purrr::map(alleles_list[[x]][[y]],
                                  \(z) ifelse(is.na(z), "Missing", z))) |>
    reshape2::melt() |>
    dplyr::group_by(L2) |>
    dplyr::summarize(none_missing  = all(value != "Missing"),
                     keep_allele   = ifelse(keep_same_alleles, TRUE,
                                             length(unique(value)) > 1),
                     .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::filter(none_missing, keep_allele) |>
    dplyr::pull(L2)
}

# norm_hamm_dist ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Normalised Hamming distance between two allele vectors x and y over a set of
# variants. Returns the proportion of compared positions that differ.
# Returns NA if fewer than min_var positions are non-missing, or if more than
# n_na positions are missing (when n_na is specified).
# possible_alleles: named list of valid alleles per variant; positions where
# either cell carries an unexpected allele are set to NA before comparison.
norm_hamm_dist <- function(x, y, variants_vec,
                            min_var         = 3,
                            n_na            = NULL,
                            possible_alleles = NULL) {
  if (!all(names(x) == names(y)))
    stop("Names of the two allele lists must be identical.")

  if (!is.null(possible_alleles)) {
    make_var_na <- purrr::map_lgl(
      variants_vec,
      \(v) !(x[[v]] %in% possible_alleles[[v]]) |
            !(y[[v]] %in% possible_alleles[[v]])
    )
    x[make_var_na] <- NA
    y[make_var_na] <- NA
  }

  z <- purrr::map2_lgl(x, y, \(a, b) a == b)[variants_vec]

  if (sum(!is.na(z)) < min_var) return(NA)

  enough_coverage <- is.null(n_na) || sum(is.na(z)) <= n_na
  if (enough_coverage) 1 - sum(z, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(!is.na(z)) else NA
}
```

# Read in data

```{r read-data, message=FALSE}
patient_info_df <- readr::read_tsv(patient_info_filepath, show_col_types = FALSE)
filenames_df    <- readr::read_tsv(filenames_filepath,    show_col_types = FALSE)

SNP_GT_filename_df <- filenames_df |>
  dplyr::select(patient, USI, stage, pool, filename = SNP_GT_filename)

# Load all SNP genotype files, adding sample metadata columns
SNP_df <- purrr::pmap(
  SNP_GT_filename_df,
  \(patient, USI, stage, pool, filename)
    readr::read_tsv(filename, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    tibble::add_column(patient = patient, USI = USI,
                       stage = stage, pool = pool, .before = 0) |>
    dplyr::mutate(variant = stringr::str_c(chr, pos, sep = ":"))
) |>
  dplyr::bind_rows()

vcf_n_cells_df <- SNP_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(patient, USI, stage, pool) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_cells = length(unique(cell_barcode)), .groups = "drop")

# Separate pooled and non-pooled samples
nonpooled_SNP_df <- SNP_df |> dplyr::filter(is.na(pool))

pooled_SNP_df <- SNP_df |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pool)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(patient = stringr::str_c("MRD_Pool", pool),
                USI     = stringr::str_c("MRD_Pool", pool)) |>
  unique()
```

# Explore data

### Mission Bio scDNA samples available

```{r samples-available, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=2.5}
samples_available_plot_object <- patient_info_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    stage   = dplyr::case_match(stage,
                                "IDX" ~ "Initial diagnosis (IDX)",
                                "MRD" ~ "Minimal residual disease (MRD)",
                                "RLP" ~ "Relapse (RLP)"),
    patient = dplyr::case_when(stringr::str_starts(USI, "P") ~ USI, TRUE ~ patient),
    pool    = dplyr::case_when(is.na(pool) ~ "Not pooled", TRUE ~ as.character(pool))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pool = as.factor(pool)) |>
  dplyr::count(patient, stage, pool) |>
  dplyr::mutate(n = ifelse(n == 1, "", n)) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = patient, y = forcats::fct_rev(stage),
                               fill = pool, label = n)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile() +
  ggplot2::geom_text(color = "white") +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Patient sample availability", x = "Patient", y = NULL,
                fill  = "MRD sample pools") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = mrd_pool_colors) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
                 legend.direction = "horizontal",
                 axis.text.x      = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(plots_pdf_dir, "samples_available.pdf"),
                samples_available_plot_object, width = 7.5, height = 7.5 / 3)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(plots_png_dir, "samples_available.png"),
                samples_available_plot_object, width = 7.5, height = 7.5 / 3)
samples_available_plot_object
```

Notes:

- Pool 1 failed
- Pool 4 not available on Mission Bio portal
- PT 20, 21, 23 use a different naming scheme
- PT 20 has 3 relapse samples

### Sequenced cells vs. loaded cells

```{r loaded-vs-sequenced, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4.6}
n_cells_df <- patient_info_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(vcf_n_cells_df, by = c("patient", "USI", "stage", "pool")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    patient = dplyr::case_when(stringr::str_starts(USI, "P") ~ USI, TRUE ~ patient),
    pool    = dplyr::case_when(is.na(pool) ~ "Not pooled", TRUE ~ as.character(pool))
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pool = as.factor(pool)) |>
  tidyr::replace_na(list(pool_proportion = 1)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(n_cells_loaded_adj = n_cells_loaded * pool_proportion,
                n_cells_adj        = n_cells        * pool_proportion)

loaded_vs_sequenced_cells_plot_object <- n_cells_df |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = n_cells_loaded_adj, y = n_cells_adj)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(color = pool), shape = 16) +
```

# Genotype quality

### Distribution of GQ scores

```{r gq-distribution}
all_SNP_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(nonpooled_SNP_df, pooled_SNP_df)
n_snps     <- nrow(all_SNP_df)

# Summary table
all_SNP_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(`Genotype Quality` = dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(quality)  ~ "Missing GT",
    quality == 99   ~ "GQ = 99 (max)",
    quality >= 20   ~ "20 <= GQ < 99",
    TRUE            ~ "GQ < 20"
  )) |>
  dplyr::count(`Genotype Quality`) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Proportion = n / n_snps) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(Proportion)) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

```{r gq-plot, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4.6}
prop_lt_20 <- all_SNP_df |> dplyr::filter(is.na(quality) | quality < 20)  |> nrow() / n_snps
prop_lt_99 <- all_SNP_df |> dplyr::filter(is.na(quality) | quality < 99)  |> nrow() / n_snps

gq_distribution_plot_object <- all_SNP_df |>
  dplyr::mutate(quality = ifelse(is.na(quality), -1, quality)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(quality) |>
  dplyr::count(quality) |>
  dplyr::mutate(cum_sum  = cumsum(n),
                cum_prop = cum_sum / n_snps) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = quality, y = cum_prop)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = c(prop_lt_20, prop_lt_99), lty = 2, color = "red") +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", label = "GQ < 20", x = -1, y = prop_lt_20 - 0.01,
                    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, color = "red") +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", label = "GQ < 99", x = -1, y = prop_lt_99 - 0.01,
                    hjust = 0, vjust = 1, color = "red") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-1, 0, 20, 99),
                               minor_breaks = NULL,
                               labels = c("", 0, 20, 99)) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, .1), limits = c(0, 1),
                               labels = scales::percent) +
  ggplot2::labs(x     = "Genotype Quality",
                y     = "Cumulative Percentage",
                title = "Over 80% of genotype calls are useful; over 50% have maximum quality") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(plots_pdf_dir, "gq_distribution.pdf"),
                gq_distribution_plot_object, width = 7.5, height = 7.5 / phi)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(plots_png_dir, "gq_distribution.png"),
                gq_distribution_plot_object, width = 7.5, height = 7.5 / phi)
gq_distribution_plot_object
```

# Consensus genotypes for non-pooled samples

```{r consensus-genotypes}
# Build three parallel structures over USI > stage > variant:
#   - proportion of cells with a consistent genotype  (for QC violin)
#   - consensus allele string                          (for matching)
#   - consensus genotype string                        (for pool-level plots)
build_nested_list <- function(snp_df, fn_args) {
  split(snp_df, f = snp_df$USI) |>
    purrr::map(\(x) split(x, f = x$stage)) |>
    purrr::map_depth(.depth = 2, .f = \(y) split(y, f = y$variant)) |>
    purrr::map_depth(.depth = 3, .f = \(z) do.call(get_consensus_genotype,
                                                      c(list(snp_df = z), fn_args)))
}

nonpooled_genotype_props_list   <- build_nested_list(nonpooled_SNP_df,
                                                      list(return_prop = TRUE))
nonpooled_genotype_alleles_list <- build_nested_list(nonpooled_SNP_df, list())
nonpooled_genotype_list         <- build_nested_list(nonpooled_SNP_df,
                                                      list(return_genotype = TRUE))
```

### Percentage of cells with a consensus genotype

```{r consensus-violin}
nonpooled_genotype_props_list |>
  reshape2::melt() |>
  dplyr::rename(Variant = L3) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = Variant, y = value)) +
  ggplot2::geom_violin(draw_quantiles = 0.5) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, lty = 2, color = "red") +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(shape = 16, alpha = 0.25, width = 0.1, height = 0) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ggplot2::labs(y     = "Percentage of cells",
                title = "Percentage of cells with a consistent genotype") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### Genotypes of pooled MRD samples

```{r pooled-patients}
pooled_mrd_samples <- patient_info_df |>
  split(patient_info_df$pool) |>
  purrr::map(\(x) x |> dplyr::pull(patient))

patient_idx_usi_in_mrd_pool_df <- patient_info_df |>
  dplyr::filter(stage %in% c("IDX", "MRD")) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols     = c(patient),
                     names_from  = stage,
                     values_from = c(pool, USI)) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pool_MRD)) |>
  dplyr::select(-pool_IDX) |>
  dplyr::mutate(pool_MRD = as.character(pool_MRD))
```

```{r consensus-by-pool-tile}
# Tile plot: IDX consensus genotype proportion per variant per pool
nonpooled_genotype_props_list |>
  reshape2::melt() |>
  dplyr::select(USI = L1, stage = L2, variant = L3, proportion = value) |>
  dplyr::filter(stage == "IDX", USI %in% patient_idx_usi_in_mrd_pool_df$USI_IDX) |>
  dplyr::left_join(patient_idx_usi_in_mrd_pool_df, by = c("USI" = "USI_IDX")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    value_discrete = dplyr::case_when(
      proportion == 1    ~ "100%",
      proportion >= 0.95 ~ ">= 95%",
      proportion >= 0.90 ~ ">= 90%",
      TRUE               ~ "< 90%"
    ),
    value_discrete        = factor(value_discrete,
                                   levels  = c("100%", ">= 95%", ">= 90%", "< 90%"),
                                   ordered = TRUE),
    mrd_pool              = stringr::str_c("Pool ", pool_MRD),
    IDX_sample_display_name = ifelse(USI == USI_MRD, USI,
                                     stringr::str_c(patient, ": ", USI))
  ) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = variant, y = IDX_sample_display_name,
                               fill = value_discrete)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = dplyr::vars(pool_MRD), space = "free", scales = "free") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_brewer(palette = "PuOr", direction = -1) +
  ggplot2::labs(x     = "Variant", y = "IDX sample",
                title = "SNPs show consistent consensus genotypes",
                fill  = "Percentage of cells\nwith consistent genotype") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x    = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                 legend.position  = "bottom",
                 legend.direction = "horizontal")
```

```{r consensus-genotype-by-pool-plot}
                IDX_sample_display_name = ifelse(USI == USI_MRD, USI,
                                                  stringr::str_c(patient, ": ", USI))) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = variant, y = IDX_sample_display_name,
                               fill = genotype)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile() +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(rows = dplyr::vars(pool_MRD), space = "free", scales = "free") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Greens", direction = -1) +

                title = "SNPs provide informative differences within pool",
                fill  = "Consensus genotype") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x    = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
                 legend.position  = "bottom",
                 legend.direction = "horizontal")

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(plots_pdf_dir, "consensus_genotypes_by_pool.pdf"),
```

# Distance metric

$$\text{Normalised Hamming distance (H)} = 1 - \frac{\text{# matching alleles}}{\text{# non-missing alleles}}$$

### Non-pooled IDX/MRD pairs

```{r nonpooled-hamming}
known_pairs <- c("PAPDNB", "PAPDUV", "PAPHWH", "PAXYMC",
                 "PAYBCZ", "PAYCFJ", "PAYMKH")

informative_variants_list <- purrr::map(
  known_pairs,
  \(x) get_informative_variants(nonpooled_genotype_alleles_list,
                                  c(x, x), c("IDX", "MRD"))
) |> setNames(known_pairs)

npkp_mrd_cell_barcode_list <- purrr::map(
  known_pairs,
  \(x) nonpooled_SNP_df |>
    dplyr::filter(USI == x, stage == "MRD") |>
    dplyr::pull(cell_barcode) |>
    unique()
) |> setNames(known_pairs)

npkp_mrd_SNP_df <- nonpooled_SNP_df |>
  dplyr::filter(USI %in% known_pairs, stage == "MRD")

npkp_mrd_cell_barcode_allele_list <- split(npkp_mrd_SNP_df,
                                            f = npkp_mrd_SNP_df$USI) |>
  purrr::map(\(x) split(x, x$cell_barcode)) |>
  purrr::map_depth(.depth = 2, .f = get_cell_alleles)

# Compute Hamming distance for each MRD barcode vs. its IDX consensus
npkp_hamm_list <- purrr::map(known_pairs, \(pt) {
  purrr::map(npkp_mrd_cell_barcode_list[[pt]], \(bc) {
    norm_hamm_dist(
      nonpooled_genotype_alleles_list[[pt]][["IDX"]],
      npkp_mrd_cell_barcode_allele_list[[pt]][[bc]],
      informative_variants_list[[pt]],
      possible_alleles = nonpooled_genotype_alleles_list[[pt]][["IDX"]]
    )
  }) |> setNames(npkp_mrd_cell_barcode_list[[pt]])
}) |> setNames(known_pairs)
```

```{r nonpooled-hamming-plot}
known_pair_hamming_distribution_plot_object <- npkp_hamm_list |>
  reshape2::melt() |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    value = dplyr::case_when(
      is.na(value)  ~ "Missing",
      value == 0    ~ "H = 0",
      value < 0.1   ~ "H < 0.1",
      value < 0.2   ~ "H < 0.2",
      value < 0.3   ~ "H < 0.3",
      value < 0.4   ~ "H < 0.4",
      value < 0.5   ~ "H < 0.5",
      value >= 0.5  ~ "H >= 0.5"
    ),
    value = factor(value,
                   levels  = c("H = 0", "H < 0.1", "H < 0.2", "H < 0.3",
                                "H < 0.4", "H < 0.5", "H >= 0.5", "Missing"),
                   ordered = TRUE)
  ) |>
  dplyr::count(value, L1) |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = L1, y = n,
                               fill = forcats::fct_rev(value))) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = "fill") +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  ggplot2::labs(x     = "Patient",
                y     = "Percentage",
                fill  = "Distance",
                title = "Distance between MRD barcodes and IDX consensus alleles") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(plots_pdf_dir, "known_pair_hamming_distribution.pdf"),
                known_pair_hamming_distribution_plot_object,
                width = 7.5, height = 7.5 / phi)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(plots_png_dir, "known_pair_hamming_distribution.png"),
                known_pair_hamming_distribution_plot_object,
                width = 7.5, height = 7.5 / phi)
known_pair_hamming_distribution_plot_object
```

# Pooled IDX and MRD samples

### Informative variants distinguish between pooled samples

```{r pooled-informative-variants}
# Informative variants are those non-missing in all IDX samples within a pool
# AND differing across at least two samples (keep_same_alleles = FALSE)
informative_variants_list <- purrr::map(
  c("2", "3", "5", "6"),
  \(x) get_informative_variants(
    nonpooled_genotype_alleles_list,
    sample_ids = patient_idx_usi_in_mrd_pool_df |>
      dplyr::filter(pool_MRD == x) |>
      dplyr::pull(USI_IDX),
    stages = rep("IDX", length(pooled_mrd_samples[[x]])),
    keep_same_alleles = FALSE
  )
) |> setNames(c("2", "3", "5", "6"))
```

### Calculate H for pooled samples

```{r pooled-hamming}
pooled_allele_list <- split(pooled_SNP_df, f = pooled_SNP_df$pool) |>
  purrr::map(\(x) split(x, x$cell_barcode)) |>
  purrr::map_depth(.depth = 2, .f = get_cell_alleles)

pooled_IDX_usi_list <- patient_idx_usi_in_mrd_pool_df |>
  split(patient_idx_usi_in_mrd_pool_df$pool_MRD) |>
  purrr::map(\(x) x$USI_IDX)

h_cutoff <- 0.5

pool_hamm_list <- purrr::map(c("2", "3", "5", "6"), \(pool) {
  # Build combined possible-allele list across all IDX samples in this pool
  possible_alleles_list <- nonpooled_genotype_alleles_list[[
    pooled_IDX_usi_list[[pool]][1]]][["IDX"]]

  for (pt in pooled_IDX_usi_list[[pool]][-1]) {
    possible_alleles_list <- purrr::map2(
      possible_alleles_list,
      nonpooled_genotype_alleles_list[[pt]][["IDX"]],
      c
    )
  }

  purrr::map(names(pooled_allele_list[[pool]]), \(bc) {
    purrr::map(pooled_IDX_usi_list[[pool]], \(pt) {
      norm_hamm_dist(
        nonpooled_genotype_alleles_list[[pt]][["IDX"]],
        pooled_allele_list[[pool]][[bc]],
        informative_variants_list[[pool]],
        possible_alleles = possible_alleles_list
      )
    }) |> setNames(pooled_IDX_usi_list[[pool]])
  }) |> setNames(names(pooled_allele_list[[pool]]))
}) |> setNames(c("2", "3", "5", "6"))
```

### Pool 2 — PAVXLK + PARNLW + PAVEPS (three-sample pool)

Pool 2 contains three IDX samples, so the Hamming distances form a 3D
simplex. A ternary plot (ggtern) is appropriate here; pools with only two
samples use standard xy scatter plots below.

```{r pool-2-ternary}
pool_2_plot_object <- pool_hamm_list |>
  reshape2::melt() |>
  dplyr::filter(L1 == "2") |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = L3, values_from = value) |>
  dplyr::count(PAVXLK, PARNLW, PAVEPS) |>
  dplyr::mutate(assigned_to = dplyr::case_when(
    PAVXLK < h_cutoff & PARNLW > h_cutoff & PAVEPS > h_cutoff ~ "PAVXLK",
    PAVXLK > h_cutoff & PARNLW < h_cutoff & PAVEPS > h_cutoff ~ "PARNLW",
    PAVXLK > h_cutoff & PARNLW > h_cutoff & PAVEPS < h_cutoff ~ "PAVEPS",
    TRUE ~ "None"
  )) |>
  ggtern::ggtern(ggtern::aes(x = PAVXLK, y = PARNLW, z = PAVEPS,
                              color = assigned_to, size = n)) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 16) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Hamming distance of pooled barcodes:\nPAVXLK + PARNLW + PAVEPS (Pool 2)",
                size  = "Number of\nbarcodes",
                color = "Assigned") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw()

pool_2_plot_object
```

# Assignment summary

### Barcodes assigned per pool

```{r assigned-barcodes-plot}
assigned_barcode_counts_df <- pool_hamm_list |>
  reshape2::melt() |>
  dplyr::group_by(L1, L2) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_samples   = length(unique(L3)),
                   n_lt        = sum(value < h_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_gt        = sum(value > h_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
                   assigned    = n_lt + n_gt == n_samples,
                   assigned_to = ifelse(assigned, L3[which(value < h_cutoff)], NA),
                   n_na        = sum(is.na(value)),
                   .groups     = "drop") |>
  dplyr::count(L1, assigned_to) |>
  dplyr::left_join(patient_info_df |> dplyr::select(patient, USI) |> unique(),
                   by = c("assigned_to" = "USI")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    assigned_to = ifelse(stringr::str_starts(assigned_to, "P"), assigned_to, patient),
    L1          = stringr::str_c("Pool ", L1)
  )

total_assigned_df <- assigned_barcode_counts_df |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(assigned_to)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(L1) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_total_assigned = sum(n))

n_barcodes_assigned_plot_object <- assigned_barcode_counts_df |>
  dplyr::left_join(total_assigned_df, by = "L1") |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    patient_info_df |>
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(pool)) |>
      dplyr::select(USI, pool_proportion) |>
      dplyr::mutate(USI = dplyr::case_when(
        USI == "4232" ~ "PT21", USI == "3398" ~ "PT23", TRUE ~ USI)),
    by = c("assigned_to" = "USI")
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(loading_prop_text =
                  "Expected barcodes based on cell loading proportion") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = n, y = assigned_to, label = n)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(x = n_total_assigned * pool_proportion,
                                    color = loading_prop_text), shape = 16) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(hjust = 1, color = "white", nudge_x = -10) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ L1, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Number of barcodes assigned", y = "Assigned to", color = NULL) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = "red") +
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(plots_pdf_dir, "n_barcodes_assigned.pdf"),
                n_barcodes_assigned_plot_object, width = 7.5, height = 7.5 / phi)
```

### Proportion of pooled barcodes assigned

```{r assigned-proportion}
assigned_barcode_counts_df |>
  dplyr::group_by(L1) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_assigned = sum(n[!is.na(assigned_to)]),
                   n_cells    = sum(n),
                   .groups    = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(prop_assigned = n_assigned / n_cells) |>
  dplyr::select(Pool = L1, Assigned = n_assigned,
                `Total cells` = n_cells, Proportion = prop_assigned) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

### Output pooled barcode assignments

```{r output-assignments}
pool_hamm_list |>
  reshape2::melt() |>
  dplyr::group_by(L1, L2) |>
  dplyr::summarize(n_samples   = length(unique(L3)),
                   n_lt        = sum(value < h_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
                   n_gt        = sum(value > h_cutoff, na.rm = TRUE),
                   assigned    = n_lt + n_gt == n_samples,
                   assigned_to = ifelse(assigned, L3[which(value < h_cutoff)], NA),
                   n_na        = sum(is.na(value)),
                   .groups     = "drop") |>
  dplyr::select(pool = L1, barcode = L2, assigned_to) |>
  dplyr::left_join(patient_info_df |> dplyr::filter(stage == "IDX") |>
                     dplyr::select(USI, patient), by = c("assigned_to" = "USI")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(patient_info_df |> dplyr::filter(stage == "MRD") |>
                     dplyr::select(USI, patient), by = "patient") |>
  dplyr::select(pool, barcode, assigned_to = USI) |>
  readr::write_tsv(file = pooled_barcode_assignments_filepath)
```
